text: The paper's 3rd-order Chebyshev post filter was re-simulated on a much finer mesh: maximum cell 0.20 mm instead of 0.30 mm, 0.04 mm instead of 0.06 mm at the posts, and 6 instead of 4 cells across the substrate. The 3 dB centre frequency moved by -10 MHz (0.10 %), the 3 dB bandwidth by +0 MHz and the IL at 10 GHz by +0.02 dB. The largest difference in |S21| inside the passband is 0.41 dB. The standard mesh used for all other runs is therefore converged to well within the validation tolerances.
